compatibility_findings.stroke_width: Selected roots use the Open Peeps filled-path language with a nominal root stroke-width of 1; custom sign layers use rounded, proportionate outlines.
compatibility_findings.reason: Category viewBoxes and dimensions differ. A controlled composition needs per-category scale, translation, stacking order and attachment anchors.
compatibility_findings.flattened_templates: Composed Bust, Standing and Sitting template files are useful as references but may be harder to separate safely than the atom files.
compatibility_findings.arm_rule: Any generic body arms must be replaced by a Kinder Signs custom reviewed arm/hand layer. Open Peeps is not the movement source.

excluded_from_shortlist: generic pointing or sign-like hand poses
